value.rationale: The source classifies stable composition-closed stopping models but leaves their stopping-count dispersion implicit. The theorem turns the dual law into an exact observable mean-variance curve, identifies the least-variable member at every fixed expectation-growth exponent, and shows there is no upper dispersion ceiling once \\(a>1\\). This provides a natural design frontier for selecting stable stopping models and cleanly separates growth from dispersion. It is structural rather than a parameter substitution or isolated finite computation; the exact equality cases and attainable range make the result reusable.
